articles.title: Reddit fined £14m over children’s data protection failures
articles.author: City AM
articles.summary: By:Saskia Koopman Tech Reporter Social media platform Reddit has been fined £14.47m by the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) after a probe found it unlawfully processed children’s personal information.
articles.content:
